scope: Read-only current policy/control chain and four existing scene logs. No inference, simulation, GUI, process, data, or source mutation.

findings.conclusion: GUI dx/dy are world-coordinate offsets from the baseline bowl, not the final coordinates and not robot eef coordinates.
findings.evidence: Baseline bowl X=.00554705m; scene007 dx=-.00187266 yields bowl world X=+.00367439m. Scenes008/009 yield X=-.03452786/-.06636306m at identical Y=.37309887m. Negative GUI delta and negative world target are distinct.

findings.conclusion: No sign-dependent action routing or negative-absolute-X branch found in the inspected executed path.
findings.evidence: Fresh state/RGB query, one returned first action of the ten-action horizon sent unchanged as a 7-element list; no GUI displacement transform is applied to policy actions. CSV records that pre-controller action. State/request hashes discard stale predictions. Native controller subsequently applies its own symmetric clipping.

findings.conclusion: Checkpoint normalization is unchanged; quantile normalization and inverse are affine with strictly positive scale, without quantile clipping or sign truncation.
findings.evidence: Parent, active checkpoint and training asset all SHA256 5b17954187d2a2973cdccdae7e0f10041437fa7f74e5fa687f59309cd35cd788. Action q01/q99 X=-.659193/.805798,Y=-.830897/.682889; both directions covered. Normalized zero need not mean physical zero; correct inverse restores it. Explicit ±.1 numerical round trip passed to <1e-15.

findings.conclusion: Native OSC uses world-frame delta goals, symmetric input clipping and no configured Cartesian position boundary at X=0.
findings.evidence: 20Hz control. Six arm commands clipped symmetrically [-1,1], xyz goal offset=.05m*action and axis-angle rotation=.5rad*action, fixed kp150/damping1, control_delta True, position_limits and orientation_limits None. EEF pose comes from world site_xpos/site_xmat. set_goal_position=current_world_position+delta. These are target offsets, not achieved displacement or direct velocity.

findings.conclusion: No wrong slow-action map found in the actual control run sampling configuration.
findings.evidence: Reconstructed pinned 100000-index map matches training launch SHA, covers all15052 real starts with no group overlap. Weights public60%, all approved human20%, original-rate teacher carry15%, teacher other5%. Wrapper returns original underlying sample with original native future10 window; no label scaling, cross-episode stitching or action clipping. Sampling can change learned preferences; it does not guarantee model speed. This is deliberately the 1x control model, not the 2x treatment.

findings.conclusion: Numeric state is not a conditioning input for this pi05 model; absolute world X is not supplied as an explicit numeric decision feature.
findings.evidence: pi05=True, discrete_state_input=False removes state from tokenizer; pi05 suffix omits state projection. It remains RGB+text conditioned. Sending/normalizing state for common interface does not enable pose conditioning. Images can still encode position.

findings.conclusion: Late failed-scene motion is not software zeroing: it includes small nonzero commands and measurable matching-direction movement.
findings.evidence: Rows600..799 mean xyz norm .0620/.0678, adjacent freshly regenerated EEF positions move .519/.562mm per control step. Mean commands point +X/-Y/+Z. Both runs contain hundreds of negative X/Y commands; neither has an X/Y command beyond +/-1. Scene008 has only one Z component >1 in all800 steps, subject to ordinary symmetric native clipping.

not_established: No model-side numerical output audit before unnormalization or fresh teacher-forced inference was performed. Existing CSV contains final de-normalized pre-controller actions.

No independent controlled reachability/contact test at the stalled poses was run. Cartesian position_limits=None and positive/negative action delivery do not prove collision-free reachability at the requested bowl pose/orientation.

OSC torque saturation, joint-limit proximity, singularity/Jacobian conditioning and contact force at stalls cannot be resolved from these CSVs; joint qpos/qvel, controller goals, actuator controls and contact data are not logged per step. Joint torque clipping exists at single_arm.py:254.
The scene006/007 success flag means some official On predicate; their336/422 are total executed steps, with first On153/130. Full release/retreat requires separate temporal inspection.

This is a four sequential GUI trial comparison with continuing model RNG, not a matched-seed causal test across the sign boundary. It does not establish overfit, an absolute-X learned boundary, or a single root cause.
minimal_next_validation: Use the already logged stall windows to separate command magnitude/direction from observed response; if physical reachability remains disputed, a separately authorized isolated fixed-pose/manual-controller check at one saved stalled pose should log joint limits, controller goal error, torques and contacts. No code repair is justified by this audit alone.

generic_class_default.interpretation: The explicit official pi05_libero task override, not the generic class default, controls this LIBERO setup.
